items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: if you happen, come down too and go by and Romy would be doing that same thing, practicing.

ctx.x: You know if Louie, did he read much or did he play mostly by ear in those days?

Well at that time they had, well, easy music, it wasn't hard to play. And they played mostly by note because Emmanuel was a good reader. And to keep up, that's why Louie played so hard and practiced. He practiced from the music then? Yeah, practiced from the music. He had his music, sheet music, you know, and he'd play it. Didn't suit him. He'd shake his head, take a rest, come back. Again, come back to it. When he'd get that tune finished, put that one up and get another one, you know, run over the whole…
Did you ever play clarinet? Huh?
